task:
Apply the one remaining independent Reviewer correction on the current clean Phase 9 branch at HEAD dfeee2fa6d9ce264938d369f7a2e3e029ddb52b0. Read AGENTS.md and required AIP implementation, phase, security, and publication skills before editing. Keep the change limited to packages/contracts/src/index.ts and packages/contracts/tests/contracts.test.ts. Do not publish remotely or implement later phases.

Blocking correction: align the TypeScript supervised-tool collection parsers with the existing Rust/database bounds. parseToolActionInput workspaceOrganize.moves must be non-empty and <=32, matching validate_local_action_input. parseToolSession.permissions must be non-empty and <=12, matching MAX_SESSION_PERMISSIONS. parseToolSessions must reject more than 32 records, matching list_tool_sessions LIMIT 32. parseToolAudit must reject more than 100 records, matching MAX_AUDIT_ROWS. Add explicit bounded maxima for parseWorkspaceRoots and parseToolCatalog (use conservative Phase 9 boundary maxima of 64 roots and 16 manifests) so they cannot accept arbitrary arrays. Keep item validators and all prior control-character, length, status, owner, compensation, and fixture checks unchanged. Add focused tests rejecting oversized move, permission, root, catalog, session, and audit arrays while valid arrays remain accepted. Do not broaden unrelated global parsers.

Validation before commit: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --locked; cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --locked --lib; pnpm --filter @aip/contracts typecheck; pnpm --filter @aip/contracts build; pnpm --filter @aip/contracts test; pnpm --filter @aip/desktop typecheck; pnpm --filter @aip/desktop test; pnpm --filter @aip/desktop build; pnpm secrets:scan; git diff --check. The executor may report Node spawn EPERM, but the parent will rerun those gates. Create one corrective commit with exact message `fix: bound phase 9 tool collections`. Do not push, create PR, merge, tag, release, or deploy. Report all evidence and final SHA.
constraints: Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor; no native subagents or alternate backend.
Local mutation and one scoped commit only; no remote GitHub mutation or publication.
Preserve the existing Phase 9 compensation identity, audit identifier bounds, and all safety, owner, agent, safe-mode, temporary-chat, and fixture boundaries.
